mapper.select: SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE UPPER(k.KEYWORD_NAME) = UPPER(#{keywordName}) GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME

SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY k.KEYWORD_NAME

SELECT kms.KEYWORD_ID, kms.CURRENT_RANK, TO_CHAR(kms.SHORT_DESCRIPTION) as SHORT_DESCRIPTION, TO_CHAR(kms.TREND_EXPLANATION) as TREND_EXPLANATION, TO_CHAR(kms.MAIN_EMOTIONS) as MAIN_EMOTIONS, kms.CREATED_AT, kms.UPDATED_AT FROM KEYWORD_MAIN_STATS kms WHERE kms.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} ORDER BY kms.UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ks.ID, ks.INPUT_ID, ks.SIMILAR_1_ID, ks.SIMILAR_2_ID, ks.SIMILAR_3_ID, ks.SIMILAR_4_ID, ks.SIMILAR_5_ID, TO_CHAR(ks.REASON) as REASON, k1.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_1_name, k2.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_2_name, k3.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_3_name, k4.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_4_name, k5.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_5_name FROM KEYWORD_SIMILARITY ks LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k1 ON ks.SIMILAR_1_ID = k1.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_1_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON ks.SIMILAR_2_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_2_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k3 ON ks.SIMILAR_3_ID = k3.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_3_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k4 ON ks.SIMILAR_4_ID = k4.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_4_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k5 ON ks.SIMILAR_5_ID = k5.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_5_ID != 0 WHERE ks.INPUT_ID = #{keywordId} ORDER BY ks.ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE UPPER(k.KEYWORD_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{query} || '%') GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY total_mentions DESC NULLS LAST, k.KEYWORD_NAME ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD k JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30 GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY total_mentions DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as TOTAL_MENTIONS, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as MENTION_DAYS FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE k.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND k.KEYWORD_ID != 0 GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME

SELECT kds.STATS_DATE, kds.DAILY_COUNT, TO_CHAR(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM/DD') as formatted_date, TO_CHAR(kds.STATS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date_string FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.STATS_DATE >=
TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1
TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 365
TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
ORDER BY kds.STATS_DATE ASC

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS positive_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS negative_count, NVL(COUNT(*), 0) AS total_count FROM SENTIMENT_RESULT sr WHERE sr.SOURCE_ID IN ( SELECT CAST(yc.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} UNION SELECT CAST(ic.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} ) AND sr.SOURCE_TYPE = 'comments' AND sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰', '불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정')

SELECT sr.LABEL AS emotion_label, CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰') THEN 'positive' WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') THEN 'negative' ELSE 'neutral' END AS sentiment_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SENTIMENT_RESULT sr WHERE sr.SOURCE_ID IN ( SELECT CAST(yc.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} UNION SELECT CAST(ic.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} ) AND sr.SOURCE_TYPE = 'comments' AND sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰', '불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') GROUP BY sr.LABEL, CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰') THEN 'positive' WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') THEN 'negative' ELSE 'neutral' END HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY sentiment_type DESC, count DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.* FROM ( -- YouTube SELECT SUBSTR(c.COMMENT_TEXT, 1, 4000) AS comment_text, CAST(c.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS comment_id, 'youtube' AS source_type FROM YOUTUBE_VIDEO v JOIN YOUTUBE_COMMENT c ON c.VIDEO_ID = v.VIDEO_ID WHERE v.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND LENGTH(c.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15
UNION ALL
-- Instagram SELECT SUBSTR(c.COMMENT_TEXT, 1, 4000) AS comment_text, CAST(c.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS comment_id, 'instagram' AS source_type FROM INSTAGRAM_POST p JOIN INSTAGRAM_COMMENT c ON c.POST_ID = p.POST_ID WHERE p.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND LENGTH(c.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ) t ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= NVL(#{limit}, 3)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YOUTUBE_VIDEO WHERE KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS youtube_videos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSTAGRAM_POST WHERE KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS instagram_posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS youtube_comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS instagram_comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SENTIMENT_RESULT sr WHERE sr.SOURCE_ID IN ( SELECT CAST(yc.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} UNION SELECT CAST(ic.COMMENT_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)) FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} )) AS sentiment_results FROM DUAL
